newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Phone trouble hits Geneva members of Swiss Bourse.
newsitem.headline: Phone trouble hits Geneva members of Swiss Bourse.

text.p: Technical problems at Switzerland's state telecomunications provider disrupted trading on the Swiss Exchange by members connected to the bourse system via the Geneva access point, the bourse said.
It said the outage from 0830 to 0930 GMT affected 16 banks trading on the spot market and eight banks trading on Soffex.
It said members were able to conduct limited amounts of business through other bourse members with access over Basle and Zurich.
